reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule, but every caller still decides itself whether to drop, move or keep an occurrence instead of getting one shared 'final day of this occurrence' function.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendOccurrences(config) ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(date, mode, holidays) : date` dispatch plus an isDroppedWeekendOccurrence filter appears in getNextDate, schedule-template, getUpcomingDates and the new getDatesInRange, and two separate search-window heuristics are added.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday predicates live in shared/schedules.ts and the new handler sits with the other schedule handlers in server/schedules/app.ts; the search-padding heuristic is local to app.ts while its sibling limit lives in shared.

scope.why: Changes stay within schedule date resolution, the handler, the config type and tests.

maintainability.why: The weekend/holiday decision is split across three exported helpers and re-composed at four call sites, with two different over-fetch heuristics, so a future rule change must be threaded through each caller.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, budget/schedule-template.ts moveWeekendOccurrence and shared getNextDate each compose skipsWeekendOccurrences/isDroppedWeekendOccurrence/getDateWithSkippedWeekend themselves rather than calling one occurrence-resolution function.

disguised_duplication.where: The same drop-or-move decision is reshaped as a closure (moveWeekendOccurrence in schedule-template.ts), a filter+map chain (getUpcomingDates), a loop body (getDatesInRange) and a find+if (getNextDate).

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained a holidays parameter; getNextDate gained daily-specific take/skip branches; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template each re-implement the skip-vs-move decision around the helper.
